evals.name: ado-pr-url-trigger
evals.expected_output: Detects Azure DevOps from the URL, resolves PR metadata, and checks the PR out into an isolated worktree without disturbing the user's current checkout.
expectations: Detects the platform as Azure DevOps from the URL host
Parses org, project, repo, and id from the URL rather than hardcoding them
Uses az repos pr show to resolve source/target branches and head/base commits
Creates an isolated detached git worktree instead of running git checkout in the user's working directory

evals.name: github-pr-url-trigger
evals.prompt: can you pull https://github.com/octocat/hello-world/pull/42 so I can review it in VSCode
evals.expected_output: Detects GitHub from the URL, resolves head/base and the base clone URL via gh api, fetches pull/42/head from that repository, and creates an isolated worktree.
expectations: Detects the platform as GitHub from the URL host
Parses owner=octocat, repo=hello-world, number=42 from the URL
Uses gh api repos/octocat/hello-world/pulls/42 to resolve head/base refs, commits, and the base clone URL
Fetches the head via pull/42/head so fork PRs work, then creates an isolated worktree

evals.name: surface-diff-in-editor
evals.prompt: I checked out the PR worktree but Source Control shows no changes
evals.expected_output: Explains the editor behavior, checks the worktree status, and asks before resetting a reused worktree to surface the PR as staged changes.
expectations: Explains the editor Source Control panel only shows uncommitted changes, so a committed PR branch looks empty
Computes the merge-base between head and base commits
Does not reset a reused worktree without explicit approval and preserves any human edits
Warns the user not to run git pull in the worktree

evals.name: post-human-dictated-comment
evals.prompt: post comment on line 53 of src/container/pageWrite.ts - this returns before the lock is released
evals.expected_output: Parses file/line/body and posts the human's verbatim text as an inline comment via the platform-appropriate mechanism.
expectations: Parses the request into file=src/container/pageWrite.ts, line=53, and the body text
Posts the human's text verbatim without rewriting or expanding it
For ADO uses the ado MCP tool or the az rest fallback with a threadContext anchored to the file and line
For GitHub uses gh api to post an inline comment anchored to the file and line

evals.name: ai-drafted-comment-on-request
evals.prompt: draft a comment on the null check in pageWrite.ts about the missing validation, then post it
evals.expected_output: Drafts a terse high-signal comment for the specified spot, shows it for approval, and posts only after the human approves.
expectations: Drafts a concise comment (1-3 sentences) citing the specific file and line
Presents the draft to the human for approval before posting
Does not post until the human approves
Keeps the comment high-signal and does not add praise, summaries, or style nits

evals.name: does-not-clobber-user-checkout
evals.prompt: review this ADO PR locally but I have uncommitted work on my current branch
evals.expected_output: Uses an isolated worktree so the user's current checkout and uncommitted work are never touched.
expectations: Does not run git checkout or gh pr checkout in the user's working directory
Creates a separate git worktree as a sibling of the repo root
The user's current branch and uncommitted changes remain untouched
Keeps the review worktree available and describes cleanup only on human request

evals.name: different-origin-repository
evals.prompt: Pull https://github.com/octocat/hello-world/pull/42 for review. My checkout's origin is a fork of a different repository.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the PR's base clone URL and uses it for both head and base fetches, without relying on origin.
expectations: Fetches pull/42/head from the base repository clone URL returned by the PR API
Checks the fetched head SHA against PR metadata
Does not fetch the PR from the unrelated origin remote

evals.name: preserve-review-worktree
evals.prompt: I'm done reading the PR for now. I added a scratch file and some notes in its worktree.
evals.expected_output: Leaves the review worktree intact and reports its path instead of force-removing human work.
expectations: Does not run git worktree remove --force
Preserves untracked files and human edits
Requests explicit approval before any destructive cleanup

evals.name: ado-fork-source
evals.prompt: Review this ADO PR locally: https://dev.azure.com/myorg/myproject/_git/myrepo/pullrequest/1234. It comes from a fork.
evals.expected_output: Uses forkSource.repository.remoteUrl for the head and repository.remoteUrl for the base, preserving the metadata commit SHAs.
expectations: Fetches the head commit from the fork's source clone URL
Fetches the base commit from the target repository clone URL
Does not assume origin contains either commit
